base_tree.description: Full Linux 6.6 + Exynos 1580 driver source. In-tree (committed).

source_layers.name: base
source_layers.provides: Base kernel + mx8855 SoC drivers (5G variant config)
source_layers.sha256: PENDING - fill from your copy of X526NKOU7CZE3_kernel.tar.gz

source_layers.name: dts
source_layers.provides: SM-X520 (gts10fewifi) board: .dtso overlays, defconfig, lego.bzl, battery_auth
source_layers.sha256: PENDING - fill from your copy of X520XXU7CZE3_kernel.tar.gz

source_layers.name: update
source_layers.provides: CZI2 security + firmware blobs (overwrites CZE3). Applied LAST.
source_layers.sha256: PENDING - fill from your copy of X526NKOSBCZI2_kernel.tar.gz

unpack_order: base -> dts -> update (do not reorder: CZI2 firmware must win, and dts supplies the .dtso/defconfig)

ubuntu_edits: Samsung/Android security disabled: SECURITY_DEFEX, PROCA, FIVE, KNOX_NCM, SECURITY_KUMIHO, SECURITY_SEATD, SECURITY_DSMS (lines ~316-332)
systemd/desktop enabled: DEVTMPFS, DEVTMPFS_MOUNT, TMPFS_POSIX_ACL, VT, VT_CONSOLE, FRAMEBUFFER_CONSOLE, VETH (lines ~335-341)
config.note: Edits are applied directly in the committed defconfig (the file Bazel --config=mx8855_user selects). Any future Samsung source refresh must re-apply these lines.
